# How this wiki works

The wiki is a static site in the repo's `wiki/` folder, published by GitHub Pages with no build step. It is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript modules. Three libraries are loaded from cdnjs, with copies in `js/vendor` as a fallback: marked for Markdown, DOMPurify for sanitizing, and a trimmed highlight.js for code.

## Files

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `index.html` | The shell: sidebar, toolbar, page area and dialogs |
| `css/style.css` | The whole theme. Colour and material tokens are defined once on `:root` |
| `js/app.js` | State, the sidebar, page loading, drafts, saving, undo and keyboard shortcuts |
| `js/doc.js` | The document layout |
| `js/board.js` | The canvas layout: pan, zoom, dragging, resizing and drawing |
| `js/cards.js` | The card model and a renderer for each card type |
| `js/edit.js` | Editing in place: WYSIWYG text, the slash menu, page links, code, tables and media controls |
| `js/markdown.js` | Markdown rendering with page links and callouts, and the HTML to Markdown serializer |
| `js/search.js` | The search index, the search dialog and backlinks |
| `js/github.js` | Everything that writes to GitHub |
| `js/storage.js` | Drafts and per browser view state in localStorage |
| `js/dom.js`, `js/icons.js` | A small element builder and inline Lucide icons |
| `pages/index.json` | The page list with titles, categories and layouts |
| `pages/<slug>.json` | One file per page |
| `assets/` | Uploaded images and video |

## Pages and cards

A page is a title, a layout and a list of cards:

In a document the cards are shown in array order and carry no position. On a canvas every card also has `x`, `y`, `w`, `h` and `z`, and text cards grow to fit their content, with `h` as the minimum.

Text cards store Markdown, even though they are edited visually. When a text block loses focus, the editor turns its HTML back into Markdown, so the page files in the repo stay readable and can be edited by hand. Page links are written `[[slug]]` and callouts `> [!NOTE]`, the same syntax Obsidian and GitHub use. BBCode and raw HTML cards are still supported through the source editor.

## Saving

Every change is written to localStorage as a draft, along with a hash of the repo version it started from. Save collects every draft, the page index and any deleted pages and writes them in one commit through the Git Data API: it reads the branch head, creates a tree on top of it, creates a commit and moves the branch. Uploads go through the Contents API as commits of their own.

After a save, the saved pages are kept locally as publishing until the Pages deploy catches up, so a reload does not flash back to the old version. When a page loads, its draft is compared with the repo copy. A draft identical to the repo is dropped, and a draft started from an older repo version shows the conflict banner instead of silently winning.

## Safety

Everything rendered, raw HTML cards and pasted content included, goes through DOMPurify before it reaches the page. The token is only read by `github.js` and only sent to `api.github.com`. `window.__wiki` exposes read only state and a few actions for headless tests.
